description: Inspect a specific app's live Ad-o-matic integration status, 6-step Genesis Member eligibility checklist, remaining Genesis spots out of 50, and matched audience segments. Read-only; makes no server-side changes. Returns registeredInNetwork (false with onboarding instructions when unregistered), storeVerified, isGenesisMember, automaticGenesisVerificationChecklist, remainingGenesisSpotsOutOf50, matchedAudienceSegments, and recommendedNextStepsForAiAgent. Fails with an error if packageName is missing or not a valid reverse-DNS identifier. Usage: call after adomatic_onboard_app or during QA to check a specific app's readiness. Do not use to register an app (use adomatic_onboard_app) or check network-wide stats without a packageName (use adomatic_network_status).

bannerText.description: Optional sample banner copy (max 90 chars) to preview audience segment classification before shipping a build. Uses stored app copy when omitted.

packageName.description: Real reverse-DNS Android applicationId or iOS bundleId (5-120 chars; do not use placeholders like com.example.* or com.company.*).

targetAudience.description: Free-form natural-language customer group (2-6 personas, hobbies, or domain keywords plus optional age band 18-24, 25-44, or 45+). Omit if unknown to fall back to automatic metadata inference.

name: adomatic_verify_integration
